snippet.title: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From GDC 2026
snippet.description:
A Gameplay Trailer for Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster. Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster is a 2D Metroidvania in which you can take the form of different animals in order to explore and defeat enemies. Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster is coming to PC, Xbox Series X/S, PS5 and Nintendo Switch Fall 2026.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2459840/Barbarian_Saga_The_Beastmaster/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
